title: DFM Kit Director Brief (v0.4 — Style-Agnostic)
description: Zero-template production brief grounded in Design for Motion: Concept, Visual World, OKLCH Color Script, and Shot/Beat Pacing. Works for ANY visual style (2D, 3D, hand-drawn, Canvas, WebGL, editorial, collage, abstract).

visualWorld.description: Free-form visual direction derived purely from content (no preset lock-in).

medium.description: e.g. 2D editorial vector, hand-drawn Canvas, 3D macro UI, archival print collage, WebGL abstract, etc.

spatialArchitecture.description: Chosen spatial stage: continuous-world-camera | hero-morph | portal-match-cut | kinetic-typography | tactile-collage | custom

reduction.description: What this film deliberately refuses or removes.

amplification.description: The 1-2 visual variables amplified into a memorable Visual Pattern.

continuityMethod.description: How beats connect physically without PowerPoint slide fades.

colorScript.description: Filmic Color Script defining harmony, 60-30-10 area proportion budget, OKLCH/HEX roles, and emotional arc over time.

sourceNote.description: Optional reference still or extracted palette source (e.g. via dfm palette).

proportionBudget.description: Target visual area split, e.g. '65% dominant ground / 25% support surface / 10% focal accent'.

dominantGround.description: 60-75% area. Low-chroma, subtly hue-tinted (avoid dead #111 or harsh #fff unless intentional).

supportSurface.description: 20-30% area. Secondary mass or polarity-flip surface.

focalAccent.description: <= 10-15% area. High-chroma focal color reserved for primary visual attention.

secondaryAccent.description: Optional contrast hue for emotional reversals.

colorArc.description: How color temperature, polarity, or chroma evolves across the film's emotional curve.

transitionOut.description: Concrete physical bridge into the next beat (which element zooms, morphs, whip-pans, or occludes into Beat N+1).
